source.title: Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1924, p. 5 ("Local boards: nominations for the June elections")
source.publisher: Belfast News-Letter (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: Citation restored to the original page (6 Nov 2026): the 5 Nov re-citation pointed to an unrelated item; the original page OCR is poor.

note: Nomination-day report for the seven electoral divisions of Moira rural district, one member each. All the retiring members were re-elected: five were nominated and returned unopposed, and no nominations were received for Ballyleney or Bleary. At the council's annual meeting on 10 June 1924, A. Gilpin (Ballymacateer), R. Gracey (Drumnacairn) and W. G. Wilson (Ballydougan) were co-opted members (Lurgan Mail, 14 June 1924, p. 7); the report does not say which divisions they filled (A. Gilpin sat for Ballyleney from 1927). Co-options are not elections (round 2, 7 Nov 2026). Sole nomination; returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
